notes: The fix leaves out every key in `bool_options` (linenums, guess_lang, noclasses, use_pygments) from the `<code>` attributes when highlighting is off. Before this change, any value for these keys passed through parseBoolValue and became a bool or None, which made the output crash. So no output that used to render has changed.

docs/extensions/fenced_code_blocks.md (around lines 202-216 and 254-259) still says that only `use_pygments` is left out of the output. Consider adding a sentence that linenums, guess_lang and noclasses are also dropped when highlighting is off.
There is a separate problem outside this issue's scope: `hl_lines="1"` without codehilite outputs `hl_lines="[1]"` because the parsed list gets serialized. It behaved the same way before this PR.

test_ac_fr_004_* (with codehilite) pass with or without the fix. They are fine as regression guards. The tests for linenums, guess_lang and noclasses without codehilite would crash without the fix, so they do test the change.
The test names (`test_ac_fr_...`) come from the pipeline and don't follow the descriptive names used elsewhere in the file. This is cosmetic only.
summary: The fix is correct and small. When fenced_code and attr_list are used without codehilite, the code that writes key/value attributes now skips all the highlighter-only boolean options instead of only `use_pygments`. Before, these options were parsed into a bool or None, which crashed the output. Every variant from the issue now renders a plain code block. Other attributes such as data-x are still output, the codehilite path is unchanged, the full suite passes (1174 tests), and the changelog has an entry. Nothing blocks the merge. A small docs update would be nice.
